BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BE   SEMESTER: III
BRANCH: IT   SESSION : MO/2018

SUBJECT : IT3025 COMPUTER ORGANISATION & ARCHITECTURE

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) Distinguish between computer organization and computer architecture with examples. [2]
 (b) Consider three different processors, P1 P2 and P3, executing the same instruction set.
P1 has a 3 GHz clock rate and a CPI of 1.5. P2 has a 2.5 GHz clock rate and a CPI of 1.0.
P3 has a 4.0 GHz clock rate and a CPI of 2.2.
(i) Which processor has the highest performance expressed in instructions per second?
(ii) If the processors each execute a program in 10 seconds, find the number of cycles
and the number of instructions.
(iii) We are trying to reduce the execution time by 30% but this leads to an increase of
20% in the CPI. What clock rate should we have to get this time reduction?
[3]


Q2 (a) Suppose you have a machine which executes a program consisting of 50% floating point
multiply, 20% floating point divide, and the remaining 30% are from other instructions.
Management wants the machine to run 4 times faster. You can make the divide run at
most 3 times faster and the multiply run at most 8 times faster. If you make both the
multiply and divide improvements, what is the speedup of the improved machine relative
to the original machine?
[2]
 (b) Briefly explain the purpose of the Instruction Register (IR) and Instruction Buffer Register
(IBR).
[3]


Q3 (a) Define a “disabled interrupt”. [2]
 (b) Compare between short and long I/O wait. [3]


Q4 (a) If  a  computer  system contains  a  mixture  of  slow  and  fast  devices,  which  bus  timing
(Synchronous or Asynchronous) mechanism would you prefer?
[2]
 (b) Describe the split transaction technique used by the transaction layer of PCIe. [3]


Q5 (a) How does the principle of locality relate to the use of multiple memory levels? [2]
 (b) Assume there are three small caches, each consisting of 6 one-word blocks. One cache is
fully associative, the second is two way set associative and the third is direct mapped.
Find the number of misses for each cache organization given the following sequence of
block addresses: 4, 7, 6, 12, 9, 0, 24, 12, 5.
[3]


Q6 (a) Illustrate the difference between DRAM and SRAM in terms of application. [2]
 (b) For the 8-bit word 00111001, the check bits stored would be 0111. When word is read
from memory, the check bits are calculated to be 1101. What is the data word that was
read from memory?
[3]

 :::: 13/09/2018 E ::::::
